func run(items: [Int]) async throws {
 for index in stride(from: items.count-1, through: 0, by: -1) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
   group.addTask { try await save(items[index]) }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   try await group.waitForAll()
  }
 }
 for index in stride(from: items.count-1, to: -1, by: -4) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
   group.addTask { try await save(items[index]) }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   try await group.waitForAll()
  }
 }
}
